h_wording.H411: Toxic to aquatic life with long lasting effects

presence.note: A UVB filter the maker adds.

why_it_matters.text: A UVB filter, the 2-ethylhexyl ester of 4-methoxycinnamic acid, absorbing strongest near 311 nm. Sunlight turns some of it from the trans to the cis form, which absorbs less, so it slowly weakens.

approval.product: OTC Monograph M020, Sunscreen Drug Products for Over-the-Counter Human Use
approval.basis: FDA OTC monograph. M020.10(i), "Octinoxate up to 7.5 percent", in M020 as amended by Final Administrative Order OTC000039 (issued 2026-06-10, corrected 2026-08-10); the later order OTC000008-1 (Federal Register 2026-09-11) removed only aminobenzoic acid and trolamine salicylate. Checked 2026-11-15.

description: A UVB filter, the 2-ethylhexyl ester of 4-methoxycinnamic acid, absorbing strongest near 311 nm. Sunlight turns some of it from the trans to the cis form, which absorbs less, so it slowly weakens.

parts.label: The ester group
parts.sentence: A C=O joined through an oxygen to another carbon, the link an acid and an alcohol make when they combine. Water can split it back into the two.

parts.label: The ether oxygen
parts.sentence: An oxygen bridging two carbons, written C-O-C. It accepts hydrogen bonds but has no hydrogen to give, and it is slow to react.

parts.label: The benzene ring
parts.sentence: Six carbons in a flat hexagon, sharing their electrons evenly around the ring. It is stable, flat and oily, and it stacks readily against other flat rings.
